title: fix(app-shell,plugin-chatbot): the Studio AI chip reads the item label, id on the tooltip
body:
Fixes #8219

Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`'s `ChatbotEnhanced` gains one optional prop, `surfaceContextTitle`. It is additive, existing callers are unchanged, and nothing changes in the data sent to the agent.

This closes the card. Items 1 and 2 landed in PR objectui#10679 and PR objectui#10687, and item 4 was measured correct with no change (dev report on the card). This PR is item 3, the Studio AI "discussing" chip, under seat answer A (card comment 5837066449) and claim 5837423596.

## What changed

The objectui#7254 ruling: what is READ is the label; the internal id stays REACHABLE on a tooltip.

| | Chip text | Chip `title` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before | `正在讨论：dashboard · b2r4_customer_dashboard` | none |
| After, labelled leaf | `正在讨论：客户仪表盘` | `dashboard · b2r4_customer_dashboard` |
| After, unlabelled leaf or other pillar | `正在讨论：object · b2r4_customer` (unchanged fallback) | `object · b2r4_customer` |

Read from the end-to-end pin `StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel.test.tsx` (real Studio surface, real dock, real `ChatPane`, `ChatbotEnhanced` replaced by a prop recorder), zh UI. The before row is that pin's red output on the unfixed tree. No live-browser screenshot was taken.

- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the label lift only): `InterfacesPillar` gets an optional `onSurfaceLabelChange`, reporting its open leaf's label tagged with the leaf's type and name (null with no leaf, no label, or on unmount). The surface keeps it in state and hands it to `StudioChatDock`.
- `StudioAiCopilot.tsx`: `StudioChatDock` and `StudioCopilotConversation` take an optional `surfaceLabel`. The conversation passes it to `ChatPane` as a SEPARATE prop, `surfaceArtifactLabel`, only when it labels the same artifact the `?surface=` URL names. `surfaceContext` is built exactly as before.
- `AiChatPage.tsx` (`ChatPane`): the chip text uses `surfaceArtifactLabel` when given and falls back to `type · name`; `type · name` is passed as the new `surfaceContextTitle`. No new request.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: new optional `surfaceContextTitle`, rendered as the chip's `title`. Omitted, the chip renders as before (no `title`, no new attribute; pinned).

## Agent data unchanged

`context.surface` is still only the URL-derived `surfaceContext`; the label never enters it. Pinned three ways:
- `AiChatPage.surfaceChipLabel-8219.test.tsx`: the whole request body handed to the chat transport is byte-identical (`JSON.stringify`) with and without a label, and contains no label text.
- `studioSurfaceLabel-8219.test.tsx`: the `surfaceContext` prop is byte-identical with and without a reported label.
- `StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel.test.tsx`: end to end, the body's `context.surface` is exactly the pillar and the type and name, and holds no label.

## Red, then green

- Red, commit `53cae66ae3` (pins only, unfixed source): 4 new files gave `Test Files 4 failed (4)`, `Tests 7 failed | 7 passed (14)`. Failures included `expected '正在讨论：dashboard · b2r4_customer_dashbo…' to be '正在讨论：客户仪表盘'`, `expected 'Discussing: dashboard · customer_dash…' to be 'Discussing: Customer dashboard'`, and the chip `title` missing. The 7 passing were the keep-as-is pins: no-prop render, no chip without a label, the byte-identical agent data, and a label for a different artifact being dropped.
- Green, commit `1d463ca9fa`: the 4 new files plus `surfaceIdentity`, `interfacePolish`, `canvasFrame`, `DashboardPreview.loneWidget` and `studioSurfaceContext` gave `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 33 passed (33)`.

## Gates (local, at 1d463ca9fa)

- `turbo run build` over the dependency closures of both packages: 28 of 28 tasks.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: both exit 0, and `--listFilesOnly` shows all 4 new tests in the test projects. Reverse check: a number passed as `surfaceContextTitle` in `AiChatPage.tsx` gave `error TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'`, so the type-check read the rebuilt chatbot declarations. Restored from `HEAD`, proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and a matching blob hash.
- Tests: the full `packages/plugin-chatbot/` plus the machine-locale census gave 51 files, 551 tests passed. `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` plus `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/` gave 92 files, 522 tests passed.
- Lint, narrowed to the 8 changed files (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`, 8 files read): the 4 new tests have 0 errors and 0 warnings. The 4 edited sources have the same counts as their base copies (AiChatPage 0/31, StudioAiCopilot 0/1, StudioDesignSurface 1/20 with the error pre-existing, ChatbotEnhanced 0/10). No type-aware parser options are set, so no untouched file can change verdict. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `check:changeset-claims` 0 (3 pending changesets name touched files; each paragraph was read and is still true), `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0 new, `check:control-bytes` OK, `check:i18n-keys` 0 (no key changed), changeset presence OK, no-major OK.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the full `app-shell` suite and repo-wide lint (both left to CI). `check:readme-exports` hit its not-built prerequisite for packages outside the built closure (app-shell's own `dist`, cli, plugin-ai and others); no `plugin-chatbot` README row failed.

## Changesets

- `@object-ui/app-shell`: patch (a user-visible fix).
- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: minor, because a new optional public prop is a feature under semver. The bump policy gate only forbids `major`.

## Docs

The `ChatbotEnhanced` table in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` lists authorable schema keys. It does not list host-only React props such as `surfaceContextLabel`, so it gets no row. The prop is documented in its JSDoc.

Untouched: the breadcrumb and canvas-header tooltips (objectui#7254), the Publish button, `DashboardPreview` and the canvas frame.

Implemented under `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb` (the `domain:ui#3` seat's dispatch).
